meta.name: etsy-category-listing
meta.description: Etsy category page scraper: given an Etsy category URL (e.g. https://www.etsy.com/c/jewelry) and optional page number, returns paginated product listings with listingId, shopId, title, url, image, salePrice, originalPrice, currency, rating, reviewCount, shopName, isAd, freeShipping, badge from category and subcategory pages. Use when user mentions Etsy category, Etsy c/ URL, etsy.com category, browse Etsy categories, scrape Etsy category, Etsy category listing, extract Etsy category products, Etsy subcategory, Etsy jewelry, Etsy clothing, Etsy home decor, Etsy wedding, Etsy accessories, Etsy craft supplies, Etsy vintage category, Etsy category page scraper, Etsy taxonomy, get all products from an Etsy category, bulk category export from Etsy, Etsy niche scraping. Also applies to trend research within a specific Etsy category, competitor benchmarking within a category, sourcing suppliers by category, seasonal product monitoring, and paginated bulk collection driven by a category URL.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 抓取 Etsy 分类页面的商品列表与详情
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Etsy 上批量获取分类商品数据用于分析。
copy.tagline_en: Scrape product listings and details from Etsy category pages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to bulk collect Etsy category product data for analysis.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你给的 Etsy 分类网址（如 https://www.etsy.com/c/jewelry）和可选页码，自动提取该页的商品列表，包括商品ID、标题、价格、评分、店铺名等信息，并支持翻页。
howto.when: 当你提到 Etsy 分类、Etsy 分类网址、或要求抓取 Etsy 分类商品时触发。

say.text: 帮我提取 Etsy 珠宝分类第一页的商品。
抓取 Etsy 服装分类第3页的数据。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can extract product listings from a given Etsy category URL (e.g., https://www.etsy.com/c/jewelry) and optional page number, returning fields like listingId, title, price, rating, shopName, etc., with pagination support.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions Etsy category, Etsy category URL, or asks to scrape Etsy category products.

say_en.text: Extract products from Etsy jewelry category page 1.
say_en.note: Returns the listing data for that page.
